title: Agent J phone theme
description: theme.json of an Agent J theme folder (P169). Every section is optional: a missing one keeps the factory look. Colours are #rrggbb; images are PNG files next to theme.json. `agentj theme validate <folder>` checks this schema AND the file rules (pixel sizes, frames, hard pixel edges, contrast); only a folder that passes everything can be applied. Factory presets: robots (default) and dots. Whatever a theme says, the pairing, safety-code, security, offline and removed screens, the menu's shield line, the 网页版 badge, the home-screen icon and every agentj.app page stay official (x-agentj-locked).

id.description: Short name, lower-case letters, digits and -. robots and dots belong to the factory presets.

state.description: The whole chat screen is the Agent's state colour; text on it is Lotion #faf9f5, so each needs ≥ 2.5:1 against Lotion and the five must differ clearly. Dark mode deepens them automatically.

idle.description: Waiting for your next message (factory: Emerald Oasis, green).

working.description: The Agent is working (factory: Windstorm, blue).

waiting.description: Waiting for your approval (factory: Peachy Feeling, orange).

question.description: Waiting for you to pick an answer (factory: Magic Carpet, purple).

card.description: Fill of the message card on top of each page, by who sent it. Text on it is Noir #2c2b26: ≥ 4.5:1.

agent.description: Agent-to-Agent messages (factory: Dust of the Moon).

developer.description: From a developer tool (factory: Cotton Clouds).

system.description: System, scheduled task and command cards (factory: White Truffle).

menu.description: Every menu page (Settings and its pages, the command list, keyboard shortcuts …) is a full-screen dark page. Text needs ≥ 4.5:1 against the background and the panel, and so does the muted note text (the text colour at 72 %); the accent needs ≥ 3:1 against the background.

panel.description: Groups / cards on the page (factory: Noir).

accent.description: Switches that are on, the selected section, focus ring (factory: Milky Waves).

line.description: Dividers and outlines (factory: the text colour at 16 %).

dialog.description: P207: every centred dialog (usage numbers, the 在办 robots, the load line, confirmations, contact cards …) shares ONE background. Its text is Lotion #faf9f5, so the colour needs ≥ 4.5:1 against Lotion (a dark colour).

logo.description: The logo at the top left of the chat page (tap = text size). PNG, square, 128×128 or 256×256 px, ≤ 64 KiB, not animated. Pairing / security screens keep the official logo.

disc.description: Keep the light round disc behind the logo (it keeps a dark logo readable on every state colour).

send_icon.description: The glyph on the Send button (factory: the rocket). PNG with transparency, 128×128 or 256×256 px, ≤ 32 KiB: only its shape (alpha) is used, painted in Lotion; the four corners must be clear and 5–70 % of it covered.

busy.description: The background-work indicator at the top right of the reply card: one figure per Agent working in the background.

style.description: robots = dancing pixel robots (factory default); dots = round dots that softly blink.

robots.description: Your own robots (style robots; missing = the 16 factory robots). Two sprite sheets, one row per robot, 13 frames across (12 dance steps, then the bow): sheet_12 = 12×12 px art (shown 24 px, 2×) → 156 × 12·N px; sheet_18 = 18×18 px art (shown 18 px) → 234 × 18·N px. Pixels fully clear or fully opaque, ≤ 8 colours per robot, no empty frame, ≤ 32 KiB each.

names.description: One name per row, top to bottom; N = how many.

dots.description: Dot colours (style dots; missing = the 9 factory pairs). Each dot blinks between heavy and light.

x-agentj-locked: pairing, safety-code (SAS), removed and offline screens
the security badge 网页版 and its panel, the menu's shield line
the home-screen icon, favicon and manifest
every agentj.app page (official site, account, docs) and the relay

png.description: A PNG file name in the theme folder (no folders).
